lines.text: Ek JEE student. Torque ka ek sawaal. Galat! Teacher bolta hai, practice more. Wo pachaas aur sawaal karta hai. Phir bhi galat! Kyun? Because the problem was never torque.
Asli problem hai Class eleven ki trigonometry. Sin aur cos ka fark, jo usne kabhi properly seekha hi nahi.

Aur har test app sirf final answer mark karta hai. Right ya wrong. Koi nahi batata ki kaunsa step galat tha, aur gap kis class se shuru hua. So students practise the wrong thing, aur marks wahin atak jaate hain.
Meet Focs. Other apps mark the answer. Focs finds the step, aur wo class, jahan understanding toot gayi. Built on Gemini.
Dekho. Student ne answer lock kiya, Sure. And it's wrong. That's a blind spot. Ab wo bas apne rough paper ki photo kheenchta hai.
Gemini har step padhta hai, aur exact step pe rukta hai: step one, sin ki jagah cos. Ye slip nahi hai, ye gap hai. Aur Focs uska root bhi pakadta hai: vectors ko components mein todna, Class eleven.
Ek click, aur Focs chapter ko peeche trace karta hai, class by class. Har purane idea pe ek quick question. Jo sabse deep miss hua, wahi real gap hai.
Phir ek five minute fix, student ki apni language mein. Hinglish, Hindi, Tamil, Bengali. Aur phir proof. Rotational Motion, before the fix, one out of three. After, three out of three.
Teachers ke liye, poore batch ka root gap map. Kaun sa purana gap sabse zyada students ko rok raha hai? Teach that first. Aur Gap Genome dikhata hai ki ek basic idea pe kitne exam chapters tike hain.
Aur root cause sirf ek feature hai. Focs ek poora study platform hai, JEE, NEET, boards, college, sab ke liye.
Koi bhi lecture share karo, YouTube ho ya Physics Wallah. Focs ka apna OCR model board padhta hai, aur notes live likhe jaate hain.
Lecture ke beech pop quiz aata hai. Answer lock karo, Sure ya Guess. Sure aur galat? Wahi blind spot hai.
Full mock tests, bilkul NTA jaisa screen, plus four minus one marking. Aur result mein sirf score nahi, poora gap map.
Study rooms mein dost saath padhte hain. Koi lost ho, toh ek tap. Aur teacher ko live dikhta hai ki kaunsa board samajh nahi aaya.
Flashcards, daily plan, last day revision, mentors, Ask a senior, aur saat Indian languages. Sab kuch, ek hi jagah.

Under the hood: Gemini handwriting padhta hai aur har step check karta hai. Agar Gemini aath second mein jawab na de, toh ek second model bhi poocha jaata hai. JEE aur NEET ke top chapters ke liye twenty two root cause chains, app ke saath ship hoti hain. Aur poora app Google Cloud Run pe chalne ke liye ready hai.
Students ko aur practice nahi chahiye. Unhe chahiye sahi fix, sahi root pe. Focs. Find the step. Fix the root.
